units.container_s_per_video_s: seconds of one container of the kind's pool per second of episode video, amortized over `concurrency` episodes in flight per container
units.startup_s: seconds from container start to ready (@modal.enter), paid once per container
units.uncertainty: relative half-width of the error bar (0.35 = +/-35%)

note: `status`: measured | projected | placeholder | stale. `stale` entries were measured on another image and are kept for history only: lookups skip them. `requires` names worker features a rate depends on (e.g. `gpu_thread`, not wired into the exact worker yet); such entries are used only when the feature is enabled, and `flora plan` shows them as projections. `image`: the image the entry was measured or projected on. Review 4 M5: the exact rows were re-seeded from S1 / Perf-1 on the production cu128 `img_hfref`.

rates.provenance: S1 fast composite c=4 on H200: 6 episodes (81.0 video s) in 566 s = 0.143 video-h per GPU-h; generation is ~3x slower on cu128 (cold cuDNN graph builds), so this is the current image as is (docs/exact-worker.md, docs/perf-1.md)

Perf-1 projection with gpu_thread (persistent generate thread keeps cuDNN graphs warm): GPU bound drops from 6.3 to <= 3.9 GPU-s per video-s, W3-A's 0.245 video-h per container-h is the CPU/straggler ceiling at c=4 = ~0.23 video-h per container-h. Not measured until P1a-5s wires and runs gpu_thread (docs/perf-1.md)

W3-A steady-state projection (1.9 GPU-s per video-s at ~90% lock occupancy +16% contention = ~0.40 video-h per container-h); valid only with gpu_thread and a long-lived container with a warm Captioner, otherwise ~4 (the +60% bar) (docs/perf-1.md, docs/exact-concurrency.md)
W3-A run 1 sequential on the cu130 image: 4 WS-D episodes (1080p HomER, 153.6 video s) in 1,322 s on H200 = 0.116 video-h per container-h (docs/exact-concurrency.md). Not valid for cu128
W3-A run 1 concurrency 4 on the cu130 image: 626 s = 0.245 video-h per container-h (docs/exact-concurrency.md). Superseded by S1 on cu128 (7.0)

W3-A run 2 sequential on the cu130 image: 2x ALOHA 3-view (640x480, 44.0 video s) in 175 s; low resolution, 2 episodes (docs/exact-concurrency.md). 3-view lookups now fall back to the 1-view cu128 rows
W3-A run 2 concurrency 2 on the cu130 image: 105 s (docs/exact-concurrency.md)
